answer: Mechanism: Divergence-Echo Audit. Each agent maintains a private transcript chain seeded by a random saffron challenge; every epoch it returns a signed echo plus a pigment hash derived from its chain. For any two identities, auditors demand a fork proof: their chains must differ at a fresh challenge. A clone farm sharing one latent state cannot produce divergent chains, so duplicates either echo identical hashes (caught) or must fork. Cost: each Sybil needs separate persistent state, compute, and continuous divergence work; amortization collapses.
